description: Transcribe a meeting, interview, voice note or podcast episode from a public audio URL and return the text, with optional speaker labels. Also produces natural speech from text when an agent needs to answer by voice. USE FOR: - Turning a recorded meeting or voice memo into text a model can read - Adding speaker labels to an interview or podcast transcript - Speaking a short result back as an MP3 TRIGGERS: - "transcribe this recording", "speech to text", "meeting notes from audio" - "what did they say in this voice note", "podcast transcript" - "read this out loud", "text to speech", "make an mp3"

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
